entries.meaningZh: 双变色的〔遇酸、碱呈不同颜色〕
entries.en: The textbook compared two amphichroic indicators, but one photograph had been printed in black and white.
entries.zh: 教材比较了两种双变色指示剂，但其中一张照片印成了黑白的。

entries.meaningZh: 双变色的〔遇酸、碱呈不同颜色〕
entries.en: The lecturer used a colour chart to explain the amphichromatic response described in the passage.
entries.zh: 讲师用一张色卡解释了文中描述的双变色反应。

entries.en: The library's Amphicoela plates were missing, so I requested another copy of the old volume.
entries.zh: 图书馆那本旧书中的两凹亚目图版缺失了，于是我申请借阅另一本。

entries.meaningZh: 两凹的〔椎体两端均凹陷〕
entries.en: The amphicoelian vertebra was intact, but its label had come loose during transport.
entries.zh: 那块两凹椎骨完好无损，但标签在运输途中脱落了。

entries.en: The drawing showed an amphicoelous centrum from two angles, with a scale beside each view.
entries.zh: 图中从两个角度展示了一个两端皆凹的椎体，每个视图旁都附有比例尺。

entries.en: In the historical case discussion, amphicrania was distinguished from pain confined to one side.
entries.zh: 在那次历史病例讨论中，两侧头痛与仅限一侧的疼痛被区分开来。

entries.en: The old amphicreatine sample had no accompanying notebook, leaving the curator uncertain about its provenance.
entries.zh: 那份旧两性肌酸样品没有随附笔记，策展人因此无法确定它的来历。

entries.meaningZh: 两性肌酸酐〔旧生化名称〕
entries.en: An early analysis of amphicreatinine survived only as a faded typescript in the archive.
entries.zh: 一份早期的两性肌酸酐分析资料，只以褪色的打字稿形式保存在档案中。

entries.meaningZh: 双变色的〔旧术语，指酸碱反应〕
entries.en: The editor moved the amphicroic reaction diagram beside the paragraph that explained its colours.
entries.zh: 编辑把双变色反应示意图移到了说明其颜色的段落旁。

entries.en: The Amphicyonidae display remained closed while the museum replaced a cracked protective panel.
entries.zh: 博物馆更换开裂的防护板期间，犬熊科展区一直未开放。

entries.en: I could identify the amphicyte in the enlarged image, but not in the small printed copy.
entries.zh: 我能在放大图像中辨认出那个套细胞，却无法在小幅印刷图中辨认出来。

entries.meaningZh: 头感器〔线虫的感觉器官〕
entries.en: The amphid was visible in the first image but obscured in the second.
entries.zh: 第一张图像中能看到头感器，第二张中却被遮住了。
